name: Strip Metadata
description: Removes EXIF, GPS location and other hidden metadata from JPEG, PNG and WebP images before you upload them, without re-encoding. Can also give uploads random file names.

notes: Says what it needs, which is nothing beyond what Discord already shows it, and Evi holds it to that.
Works with Discord's new upload code again: uploads that skip the upload queue are cleaned too, and the "Can't find 1 part of Discord" warning is gone.
